evidence.title: GitHub - checkcheckzz/system-design-interview: System design interview for IT companies · GitHub

name: system-design-interview
summary: Handbook of system design interview tips, reading lists and reference answers for IT company interviews.
description: A repository for preparing system design interviews with a systematic approach: interview tips, basic system design knowledge, a directory of company engineering blogs, papers and articles on real products and systems, hot interview questions with references, book lists and object-oriented design notes.
contains: sections: interview tips, basic knowledge, engineering blogs, products and systems, hot questions, OOD
reference links for common design questions (CDN, key-value store, news feed, tinyurl …)
